_instructions: Setting descriptors for the configuration composer (see crates/modules/configuration/settings-catalog.json). Current values are always read live; descriptors hold no defaults.

settings.description: Days administrator alerts stay on the Notifications page before they are deleted.
examples: how long security alerts are kept

settings.description: Whether this security event raises an administrator alert on the Notifications page.
examples: stop alerting me about rate limits
notify the admin about failed logins

settings.description: How serious this security event's administrator alert is shown: info, warning or critical.
examples: show rate limit alerts as info
lower the alert level for blocked sign-ins

settings.description: How many times this security event must happen within its window before the administrator is alerted.
examples: only notify after 50 rate limited requests
tell me about every blocked sign-in

settings.description: Length, in seconds, of the window in which this security event is counted toward its alert threshold.
examples: count failed logins over an hour
use a 5 minute window for rate limit alerts

excluded./channels/**: Delivery channels: only in_app exists; ntfy, email and twilio are not available yet.
